In this video, we break down India’s $10B space tech opportunity and separate hype from reality.
We look at what changed in 2024–25, from serious startup fundraises and real launch milestones to how government support is shaping the ecosystem.
In this breakdown, we cover:
• ⁠ ⁠Why space dominates deep tech in India
• ⁠ ⁠The startups and launches that changed the narrative
• ⁠ ⁠How IN-SPACe, ISRO, and defense funding actually work
• ⁠ ⁠What comes next for founders and investors
Watch to understand whether India’s space boom is just excitement or the beginning of a long-term shift.
